svg.title: Canada Life IDP simplified Azure service architecture
svg.desc: A simplified private Azure architecture showing how enterprise channels, internal ingress, AKS, Blob Storage, Service Bus, Azure AI Content Understanding, MongoDB Atlas, human review, output services, shared controls and Canadian disaster recovery work together.
svg.text: Canada Life IDP — Simplified Azure Service Architecture
Private enterprise platform • Canada East primary • Canada Central warm recovery • Shared by business unit
Controls apply consistently across every service and business-unit workload
SSO • MFA • Conditional Access • workload identity
PIM • separation of duties • access reviews
CMK • retention • immutable evidence • legal hold
Central IT platform • scoped LOB roles and quotas
Private endpoints and managed identities connect the services shown below

text.tspan: Canada Life WAN or private Azure connectivity
Enterprise MFT/SFTP and governed Blob drops
Shared mailbox and internal event integration
Validated tenant, process and correlation metadata
Dual ExpressRoute paths with VPN fallback
Enterprise DNS resolves private service endpoints
No direct internet path to the application
Internal TLS termination and health probes
Internal API products by business unit
Next.js console and FastAPI control plane
Process, model, job and review APIs
Loads clean content and invokes analyzers
Scales on queue depth and message age
Routes to prebuilt or custom analyzers
Canadian availability remains a launch gate
Reviewer sees source, evidence and fields
Internal APIs, topics, events and batch exchange
Process, job, extraction and review state
Continuous backup and Canadian-region replica set

svg.text: These capabilities secure, deliver and operate the full document-processing path
Private endpoints • Atlas PrivateLink • resolver • Firewall routes
Scaled-down private regional stamp; Canadian data replication and quarterly recovery exercises support RTO 4h / RPO 15m planning targets
System services online • workloads scale by runbook
Premium replication • DLQ and replay controls
Atlas replica set failover • Blob geo-protection
ACR replica • tested key recovery pattern
Promote data → scale AKS → shift private DNS/routes → reconcile
Official Microsoft Azure Architecture Center icons. CIDRs, SKUs, quotas and the AI regional launch gate remain implementation decisions documented in the companion architecture specification.
